data.training_prompt: mc_ref_to_preview. Convert the supplied reference character into one strict Minecraft skin preview sheet. Highest priority: use hard square texels no finer than a valid 64x64 Minecraft UV skin; discard details rather than drawing smooth, curved, anti-aliased, high-resolution, thin, or non-block elements. Show the same character in fixed front-left and back-left full-body views, one on each half, identical scale and neutral pose. Use only classic Minecraft cuboids and textures supported by the base and outer skin layers. Accurately preserve recognizable hair, face, body colors, all clothing, footwear, and wearable accessories from the reference, but omit handheld objects and capes. Use one uniform solid blue background with no lighting, shadows, floor, reflections, glow, text, labels, interface, extra characters, or extra geometry.

inference.base_prompt: mc_ref_to_preview. Reproduce the supplied reference character as a strict 64x64-texture Minecraft skin preview, fixed front-left and back-left full-body views, pure solid blue background, no lighting, no handheld items, no cape, no extra geometry.
inference.negative_prompt: smooth texture, high resolution texture, anti-aliasing, curves, rounded body, realistic anatomy, extra geometry, protruding accessories, handheld object, weapon, cape, lighting, shadow, floor, gradient background, text, UI, watermark
